title: Review Your Recovery Evidence
subtitle: Compare what matters now with where you started.
description: Recovery may show up in function, confidence, participation, coping, understanding, or recovery time—even when symptoms still fluctuate.

fields.label: What can you do, understand, or manage differently now?
What remains difficult or important to address?
What change are you most proud of?

successMessage: Progress review saved. This can help guide your next conversation and plan.
